traits.label: Overview
traits.text: Diminutive mushroom which often appears in dense clusters on decaying wood. Its delicate, almost transparent stature and creamy-white caps make it easily distinguishable from other inky cap species. As with other members of its genus, the gills will "deliquesce" or turn into an inky black liquid as they mature, a mechanism for spore dispersal.
